name: Telemetry and Observability Guardrails
scope: signals, logs, metrics, and incident response
rules: Every fix should add or confirm an observability contract.
Recurring incidents should produce a fix-memory record or guardrail update.
evidenceRequirements: run-task correlation keys (runId, taskId, planId, ecosystemId, adapterId when available)
telemetry references attached to evidence bundle summary
